page_title: VIL 5-1 LEV | Villarreal v Levante 02/05/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' That's the end of the match.
90+8' Tajon Buchanan (Villarreal) makes a strong challenge and Alejandro Hernandez blows for a foul. It's a free kick to Levante, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
90+4' Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) is having a lively performance. He is causing problems and wanting the ball at every opportunity.
90+4' We can have a look at the statistics now, shots on target are 8:2.
90+3' An accurate pass to the edge of the box is well taken by Jon Ander Olasagasti (Levante), whose instinctive shot towards goal flashes inches wide of the right post.
90' 7 additional min. will be played.

90' 5 - 1 Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) finishes his beautiful individual effort with a superb strike from inside the box. Mathew Ryan is just a bystander as the ball flies under the crossbar. The score is 5:1.
89' Levante quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
89' The free kick will be taken by Jon Ander Olasagasti (Levante).
88' The referee points to the corner flag and Levante will take a corner.
88' Thomas Partey (Villarreal) fouls his opponent and receives a yellow card from the referee, but he is clearly not happy with the decision.

87' 4 - 1 What a beautiful moment! Tajon Buchanan (Villarreal) got to the ball and unleashed a strong shot from distance. It turned out to be a good decision as his effort found its way inside the left post. Mathew Ryan just shakes his head in disbelief. The score changes to 4:1.
86' A quickly taken corner by Levante.

86' What a save from Arnau Tenas! Karl Etta Eyong (Levante) jumps high to meet a cross and glances a promising header from close range towards the roof of the net, but the goalkeeper pulls off a brilliant save to keep it out.
84' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Tajon Buchanan (Villarreal) comes onto the pitch so that Gerard Moreno can be given a rest.

83' Karl Etta Eyong (Levante) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. Levante have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
82' Villarreal earn a corner.

82' Mathew Ryan was forced into action to thwart Ayoze Perez (Villarreal). He found himself some space after latching on to a pass and unleashed a shot to the bottom right corner but couldn't beat the keeper.
81' Willy Kambwala (Villarreal) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Pau Navarro.
79' Carlos Espi (Levante) meets a cross inside the box, but Arnau Tenas wins the battle for the ball and the chance is gone.
78' The corner is swung in but Villarreal can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
77' Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) beats the defender inside the box and lashes a shot towards the bottom left corner, but Mathew Ryan makes a brilliant reflex save to deny him. Goalkeeping at its best!
77' Substitution. Roger Brugue (Levante) in, Pablo Martinez Andres out.
76' Gerard Moreno (Villarreal) places a shot at goal from the edge of the box that bends just wide of the right post.
74' It is time for a substitution. Thomas Partey (Villarreal) is on for Dani Parejo.
74' The manager makes a subsitution with Ayoze Perez (Villarreal) coming on for Georges Mikautadze.
73' Marcelino decides to make a substitution. Alfonso Pedraza will be replaced by Sergi Cardona (Villarreal).
70' The game is interrupted now, Iker Losada (Levante) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
68' 3 - 1 Fantastic team goal! Georges Mikautadze (Villarreal) was set free in the area by Nicolas Pepe and fired past Mathew Ryan. 3:1.
68' Luis Castro prepares a substitution. Kervin Arriaga is replaced by Ugo Raghouber (Levante).
68' Kareem Tunde just cannot continue due to injury and has to be substituted. Karl Etta Eyong (Levante) replaces him.
66' Kareem Tunde (Levante) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
66' Kareem Tunde (Levante) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked.
66' Pablo Martinez Andres (Levante) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
65' Kareem Tunde (Levante) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.

62' 2 - 1 Goal! Alberto Moleiro (Villarreal) weaves his way past opponents, and he unleashes a magnificent effort from the edge of the box into the bottom right corner. Mathew Ryan had no chance of reaching it. The score is 2:1.
60' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Alfonso Pedraza (Villarreal), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
59' Georges Mikautadze (Villarreal) dummies a defender then lets fly from the edge of the box, but the ball misses the left post by a mile.
58' Dani Parejo (Villarreal) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
58' Alfonso Pedraza (Villarreal) serves up a nice cross, but Mathew Ryan punches the ball away. The referee signals a corner kick to Villarreal.
55' Renato Veiga (Villarreal) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Alejandro Hernandez had an easy-decision to make.
53' Georges Mikautadze (Villarreal) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.

51' 1 - 1 It's a goal! Carlos Espi (Levante) bursts into the box to get on the end of a whipped in cross from Pablo Martinez Andres and scores magnificently from close range into the left side of the goal. 1:1.
49' Mathew Ryan displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Georges Mikautadze (Villarreal) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
48' A pass by Kareem Tunde (Levante) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Villarreal.
47' A long ball forward to Carlos Espi (Levante) is intercepted.
46' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Ivan Romero as he is replaced by Kareem Tunde (Levante).
46' The second half has just started.
45+5' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+4' Dani Parejo (Villarreal) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
45+4' Ivan Romero (Levante) is penalised for a foul. Alejandro Hernandez had a clear view and blows his whistle.
45+4' That's a free kick to Levante.
45+3' Dani Parejo (Villarreal) once again attempts to send a defence-splitting pass, but the opposition's defence is alert and intercepts the ball.
45' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
45' Alejandro Hernandez shows a yellow card to Kervin Arriaga (Levante) for his blatant foul.
45' Alfonso Pedraza (Villarreal) meets a perfect cross on the edge of the box and rips a shot that goes well wide of the right post.
45' Gerard Moreno (Villarreal) commits a foul after unfairly battling his opponent for the ball.
43' Carlos Espi (Levante) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and fires in a shot that heads towards the middle of the goal, but Arnau Tenas makes a comfortable save.

43' Alfonso Pedraza (Villarreal) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Levante.
43' There's an opportunity for Dani Parejo (Villarreal) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
41' Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.

40' Georges Mikautadze (Villarreal) attempts to find one of his teammates inside the box with a chip pass, but one of the defending players reacts superbly and intercepts the ball. The ball goes out for a corner. Villarreal can continue in their attacking effort.
38' 1 - 0 Goal! A mistake from the defence gifted a chance to a lurking Georges Mikautadze (Villarreal), who keeps his cool and rolls the ball into the net from close range. 1:0.
37' Georges Mikautadze (Villarreal) controls a cross inside the six-yard box, but sends his shot slightly wide of the left post.
34' Poor challenge! Santi Comesana (Villarreal) is penalised for tripping and Alejandro Hernandez blows his whistle.
31' Alfonso Pedraza (Villarreal) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
30' Luis Castro is forced to make a change. Carlos Alvarez is unable to continue due to injury, Iker Losada (Levante) comes on.
28' Gerard Moreno (Villarreal) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
27' The possession of the ball – 57:43.
27' Carlos Alvarez (Levante) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
25' Dani Parejo (Villarreal) fails to find a teammate across the pitch with a long ball. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Levante.
24' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Gerard Moreno (Villarreal) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
24' Alejandro Hernandez blows his whistle after Dani Parejo (Villarreal) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
21' The linesman signals that Gerard Moreno (Villarreal) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.

20' Nice move, nice attempt! Carlos Alvarez (Levante) is teed up with a simple pass after a nice flowing move. His first time shot from mid-range looks like it's going in but curls just wide of the right post.
19' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Levante.
16' Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) overhits the corner kick and none of his teammates can their head on it. The ball goes out of play and Levante will have a goal kick.

16' Alfonso Pedraza (Villarreal) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Villarreal.
14' Close! Georges Mikautadze (Villarreal) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot narrowly over the bar.
14' Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
13' Santi Comesana (Villarreal) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger. The linesman points to the corner flag, Villarreal are going to take it.
12' Alberto Moleiro (Villarreal) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross. The linesman signals a throw-in for Levante.
12' Georges Mikautadze (Villarreal) finds space inside the box but rifles his effort miles over the bar.
11' Santi Comesana (Villarreal) picked up a rebound and unleashed a fine effort which crashed against the crossbar.
9' Ivan Romero (Levante) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Alejandro Hernandez blows for a foul.
8' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Matias Moreno (Levante).
7' Ivan Romero (Levante) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
6' Chance! Gerard Moreno (Villarreal) took a nice pass in his stride in the box, but scuffed his shot just wide of the left post.
3' Ivan Romero (Levante) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Arnau Tenas, who smothers the ball.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Villarreal will have the kick-off.
